_comment: The shared transfer market: listing price bounds, bid steps, AI seller listings and listing limits. Every player sees the same market.
_priceBoundsComment: A card's listing price range. The maximum is the first band whose fromRating the card reaches; special cards (rareflag above 1) have a higher minimum and a maximum of at least specialMaximumFloor.
_bidIncrementsComment: The smallest raise over the current bid: the step of the first band the bid is below, otherwise defaultBidIncrement.
_fairValueComment: An AI listing's reference price. Below each band's belowRating: base + perRating * (rating - fromRating) + perRatingSquared * (rating - fromRating)^2. Specials multiply by specialMultiplier + min(rareflag, 100) / specialRareflagDivisor. A stable per-card jitter of jitterMinimum + (hash % jitterSteps) / 100 is applied, then the price is clamped to the card's bounds.
_aiListingsComment: The market maintenance job keeps up to target active AI listings (ULTIMATETEAM21_MARKET_TARGET overrides it), adding at most maxPerTopUp per pass. Start and Buy Now prices are drawn around the fair value; durations are picked from durationsSeconds.
_listingsComment: Player listing durations are clamped to these bounds; searches and watchlists page with these defaults and limits.
